settings.text: The Climate Label is a trusted mark of corporate climate leadership. Companies that earn the Climate Label have been verified as meeting high standards for climate performance, transparency, and accountability. Products and services from certified brands are developed and delivered with a focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions over time. They have long-term climate targets backed up by immediate funding and actions.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A law label is a legally required tag …
settings.text: A law label is a legally required tag describing the interior filling materials of a mattress. Few companies share this before purchase. At Avocado, we have always believed differently. Inside every Avocado Green Mattress: natural latex foam rubber, organic wool, an individually wrapped coil spring unit, and a fabric cover of organic cotton and elastane (which provides stretch and recovery in the knit cover). Assembled in Fullerton, California, with domestic and imported materials. Not inside any Avocado Green Mattress: polyurethane foam, memory foam, adhesives between comfort layers, chemical flame retardants, fiberglass, or PFAS. Read the law label for every Avocado product.
